question: Which of the following countries is closest to the Nicobar Islands?
solution:
The correct answer is option 3,"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Nicobar Islands** are situated in the eastern Indian Ocean and are part of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, a Union Territory of India.
 
• The Nicobar Islands are located **closest to Myanmar**, with its northernmost island being approximately 150 km away from Myanmar's southern coast.
 
• Geographically, the Nicobar Islands lie to the south of the Andaman Islands and are separated by the **Ten Degree Channel**.
 
• Myanmar's proximity to the Nicobar Islands is closer compared to other options such as Malaysia, China, or Sri Lanka, making it the correct answer.
 
• The Nicobar Islands have strategic importance for India due to their proximity to international shipping routes and neighboring nations like Myanmar and Indonesia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Andaman and Nicobar Islands:**

 
 
• These islands form an archipelago consisting of 572 islands in the Bay of Bengal, with only a few being inhabited.
 
• The Andaman Islands lie to the north, while the Nicobar Islands lie to the south, separated by the Ten Degree Channel.
 
• These islands are of significant ecological importance, being home to rare flora and fauna.
 
 
 
• **Ten Degree Channel:**
 
 
• A water channel that separates the Andaman Islands from the Nicobar Islands.
 
• It is named so because it lies along the 10-degree line of latitude north of the equator.
 
 
 
• **Myanmar's Proximity:**
 
 
• Myanmar is geographically located to the east of the Bay of Bengal.
 
• Its southern coastline lies closest to the Nicobar Islands, making it the nearest country to this group of islands.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Importance:**
 
 
• The Nicobar Islands hold strategic maritime significance due to their location near major shipping routes in the Indian Ocean region.
 
• India maintains naval and air bases on the Andaman and Nicobar Islands to safeguard its maritime interests.
